hotels.title: Stylish Grand Mercure Mysore Escape in the Cultural Heart of Karnataka
hotels.description: Discover regal Mysore from this refined retreat on New Sayyaji Rao Road, just minutes from Mysore Palace, the vibrant Devaraja Market and the art-filled Jaganmohan Palace. Chamundi Hill’s revered temple and sweeping city views are within easy reach, while the nearby Mysore Zoo offers one of India’s oldest and most celebrated wildlife parks. Inside, contemporary rooms pair polished design with local character, and the rooftop pool frames striking panoramas across the city. For dining, La Uppu serves regional South Indian specialities, while By The Blue offers open-air grills beside the water
